checks.name: footprint_not_one_polygon
checks.meaning: The footprint is several separate outlines, not one polygon, or outlines joined only by a strip too narrow for a room: separate buildings mapped as one.

checks.name: footprint_sliver
checks.meaning: The footprint is long and thin: a wall or a fence mapped as a building.

checks.name: footprint_below_min_area
checks.meaning: The footprint is smaller than a building the dataset keeps.

checks.name: footprint_above_max_area
checks.meaning: The footprint is larger than the dataset's buildings.

checks.name: footprint_too_many_holes
checks.meaning: The footprint has many courtyards or holes.

checks.name: footprint_too_many_vertices
checks.meaning: The footprint outline has many corners.

checks.name: sharp_angle
checks.meaning: The outline has a corner too sharp for a room: a wedge-shaped building or a mapping artefact.

checks.name: thinner_than_zone_width
checks.meaning: Part of the footprint is narrower than the thinnest zone the decomposition allows (zones.min_width_m): the decomposition will probably find no zoning for it.
